summary: Requested execution of a revised experiment that delineates the main finding's blast radius: an earlier remote read and a later leader-local read share one confirmation, and the measurement compares what each requester receives. Local construction runs passed and showed the remote requester answered with the local context and left at batch index zero while the local requester's ready-to-read result carried its own context and completed, which isolates the defect to the remote reply branch. Validation reports valid with execution_requested and one experiment create; recording the resulting fact and interpretation remains pending the retained receipt.
